title: lichen-node router.rs has live eprintln PROBE debug prints on main
description: worker8 2026-09-09: rust/lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs:403,422,427,432,438,443,449,513,517,525 (at least) contain std::eprintln!("PROBE ...") debug prints in production code paths (process_authenticated_dio / process_dio_with_etx_outcome), present on origin/main. Violates the no-dead-code/no-debug-prints rule; they fire on live DIO processing. Pre-existing (not from the i72x migration); remove them. One was removed incidentally in rpl_stack/receive.rs during i72x.2's receive-gate fix.
